papers.abstract: Recent successes in autoregressive (AR) generation models, such as the GPT series in natural language processing, have motivated efforts to replicate this success in visual tasks. Some works attempt to extend this approach to autonomous driving by building video-based world models capable of generating realistic future video sequences and predicting ego states. However, prior works tend to produce unsatisfactory results, as the classic GPT framework is designed to handle 1D contextual information, such as text, and lacks the inherent ability to model the spatial and temporal dynamics essential for video generation. In this paper, we present DrivingWorld, a GPT-style world model for autonomous driving, featuring several spatial-temporal fusion mechanisms. This design enables effective modeling of both spatial and temporal dynamics, facilitating high-fidelity, long-duration video generation. Specifically, we propose a next-state prediction strategy to model temporal coherence between consecutive frames and apply a next-token prediction strategy to capture spatial information within each frame. To further enhance generalization ability, we propose a novel masking strategy and reweighting strategy for token prediction to mitigate long-term drifting issues and enable precise control. Our work demonstrates the ability to produce high-fidelity and consistent video clips of over 40 seconds in duration, which is over 2 times longer than state-of-the-art driving world models. Experiments show that, in contrast to prior works, our method achieves superior visual quality and significantly more accurate controllable future video generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/YvanYin/DrivingWorld.

analysis.key_results: 生成超过40秒的高保真一致性视频片段，时长比现有自动驾驶世界模型长2倍以上；在视觉质量和可控未来视频生成的准确性上均优于先前工作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DrivingWorld，一个用于自动驾驶的GPT风格世界模型，通过时空融合机制、下一状态预测策略、下一token预测策略以及新颖的掩码和重加权策略，实现高质量、长时长的可控视频生成。
analysis.method: 采用GPT风格的架构，结合下一状态预测（建模帧间时间连贯性）和下一token预测（捕捉帧内空间信息），并引入掩码策略与重加权策略以缓解长期漂移问题，增强泛化和精确控制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出DrivingWorld，一种GPT风格的自动驾驶世界模型，通过多种时空融合机制实现高保真、长时长的未来视频生成和自车状态预测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型（World Model），面向自动驾驶场景，通过视频生成预测未来状态，与本站关注的机器人世界模型主题高度相关。然而，摘要未明确涉及视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型或机器人操作，与本站核心主题的直接关联有限。

papers.abstract: Understanding complex animal behaviors hinges on deciphering the neural activity patterns within brain circuits, making the ability to forecast neural activity crucial for developing predictive models of brain dynamics. This capability holds immense value for neuroscience, particularly in applications such as real-time optogenetic interventions. While traditional encoding and decoding methods have been used to map external variables to neural activity and vice versa, they focus on interpreting past data. In contrast, neural forecasting aims to predict future neural activity, presenting a unique and challenging task due to the spatiotemporal sparsity and complex dependencies of neural signals. Existing transformer-based forecasting methods, while effective in many domains, struggle to capture the distinctiveness of neural signals characterized by spatiotemporal sparsity and intricate dependencies. To address this challenge, we here introduce QuantFormer, a transformer-based model specifically designed for forecasting neural activity from two-photon calcium imaging data. Unlike conventional regression-based approaches, QuantFormerreframes the forecasting task as a classification problem via dynamic signal quantization, enabling more effective learning of sparse neural activation patterns. Additionally, QuantFormer tackles the challenge of analyzing multivariate signals from an arbitrary number of neurons by incorporating neuron-specific tokens, allowing scalability across diverse neuronal populations. Trained with unsupervised quantization on the Allen dataset, QuantFormer sets a new benchmark in forecasting mouse visual cortex activity. It demonstrates robust performance and generalization across various stimuli and individuals, paving the way for a foundational model in neural signal prediction.

analysis.key_results: 在Allen数据集上预测小鼠视觉皮层活动表现出鲁棒性能和跨刺激、跨个体的泛化能力，但未提供具体指标。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出QuantFormer模型，将神经活动预测重构为分类任务，并利用动态信号量化和神经元专用token处理任意数量神经元的多元信号，在Allen数据集上实现新基准。
analysis.method: 采用Transformer架构，使用动态信号量化进行无监督量化训练，并引入神经元特定token以支持不同神经元群体规模。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: QuantFormer提出了一种基于动态信号量化的Transformer方法，将神经活动预测视为分类问题，以建模稀疏时空神经信号。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要研究神经信号预测中的量化方法，与视觉语言动作（VLA）模型或世界行动模型（WAM）无直接关联，但所提出的量化训练思想可能对高效的机器人策略模型具有一定的参考价值。

figures.caption: Comparison of encoding, decoding, and forecasting tasks . Encoding methods take a stimulus and behavioral variables at time t t to predict neural spikes at the same time point. In contrast, decoding methods do the opposite, using spike responses at time t t to predict behavioral variables for that time step. Neural forecasting differs from both, as it uses the stimulus at time t t and fluorescence traces at time t − 1 t-1 to predict neural responses at time t t .
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: QuantFormer architecture . During pretraining we employ a self-supervision quantization strategy that learns to reconstruct the randomly-masked patches along a quantization scheme. For response forecasting , [NEURON] and [STIM] tokens are prepended to the input, and neuronal response patches are masked; the model predicts for the masked patches quantized codes that are converted, through the quantization decoder learned during self-training, to a continuous signal. For activation classification , an additional [CLS] token is included in the sequence, and its output embedding is fed to the activation classifier.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: QuantFormer: Learning to Quantize for Neural Activity Forecasting in Mouse Visual Cortex
papers.title_zh: QuantFormer：面向小鼠视觉皮层神经活动预测的量化学习方法

papers.abstract: Event-triggered recording reduces the footage a surveillance camera must store, but the trigger decides how much idle video is kept, how many events are missed, and how much computation is spent. We compare six motion triggers (frame differencing, dense optical flow, MOG2, KNN, CNT, GSOC), a CNN detector, strided detection, and three motion-gated hybrids under one recording policy, on a benchmark of seven static-camera scenes (5,800 frames, 27 annotated events) with thresholds transferred to unseen scenes by leave-one-video-out. Detector-based triggers stored 19-28% of idle frames, against 36-89% for motion triggers. Under simulated camera jitter, frame differencing, optical flow, MOG2 and KNN stored 97-100% of idle frames, while detector triggers stayed below 29%. Running the detector on every 8th frame kept 99.7% of event frames at 9.8 ms of CPU per frame, cheaper and more robust than gating it with background subtraction. On VisDrone, raising YOLO11n's input from 640 to 1280 px raised AP from 15.5 to 26.8, more than a larger model, and INT8 quantization cut latency by 17% for 0.3 AP. In tracking, longer track memory raised IDF1 from 70.5 to 76.7, but every tracker recovered only 39-44% of overlapped people, because detection rather than association failed.

analysis.key_results: 检测器触发存储19-28%空闲帧，运动触发为36-89%；在模拟抖动下检测器触发仍低于29%；每8帧检测保持99.7%事件帧，每帧CPU耗时9.8ms；YOLO11n输入从640提升到1280，AP从15.5升至26.8；INT8量化降低17%延迟，AP下降0.3。
analysis.main_contribution: 在静态相机监控场景下，系统比较了六种运动触发、CNN检测器、跨步检测和三种运动门控混合方案，并分析了INT8量化对延迟和精度的影响。
analysis.method: 在七个静态相机场景的基准上，采用留一视频交叉验证评估不同触发策略；在VisDrone数据集上评估YOLO11n不同输入分辨率和INT8量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文比较了多种运动触发与检测器触发策略，并分析量化与输入分辨率对检测性能和延迟的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于监控场景中的高效推理和模型量化，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但与本站量化研究方向有间接关联。
